description: As a state legislator, I fought for and voted to pass Illinois’ minimum wage increase into law, helping raise the floor for working families and support higher local standards like Chicago’s minimum wage. That work mattered. But today, full-time work still does not cover the basic cost of living for too many families in the 7th Congressional District. In Cook County, a single adult needs more than $24 an hour just to cover essentials, and families with children need even more. That gap is why minimum wages alone are no longer enough. Living wages mean pay that reflects real costs, strong enforcement so workers keep what they earn, and lowering the expenses that erase paychecks. That is the work I am running to take on in Congress.
paid_for_by: Paid for by La Shawn K
title: Living Wages for Today’s Cost of Living - Ford for Congress
